description: This PHP file defines the AdminPluginConfiguration class, which implements the PluginConfigurationInterface. Its primary purpose is to initialize and register various service classes such as CountryService, UserService, PayGradeService, etc., into a dependency container within the context of the OrangeHRM system plugin.

classes.name: AdminPluginConfiguration
classes.description: Implements plugin configuration to initialize and register various admin-related services within the OrangeHRM plugin system.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Creates and registers service instances for country, user, pay grade, company structure, work shift, and localization services into the dependency container.
